identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase I/II Clinical Study of SHR-1501 Combined With Adbelizumab in Patients With Malignant Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase I/II Clinical Study on the Tolerability, Safety and Efficacy of SHR-1501 Combined With Adbelizumab in Patients With Malignant Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is an open, multicenter phase I/II clinical study. The entire study is divided into three stages: dose escalation, dose expansion, and efficacy expansion. Objective: To evaluate the objective response rate (ORR), safety and tolerability of the combination of SHR-1501 and adibelizumab in the treatment of advanced malignant tumors, and to provide the recommended dose (RP2D) for subsequent clinical studies.

conditions: Patients With Advanced or Metastatic Malignant Tumors
